title: Verificar canary actual de STT y canonicalizar entrypoints
mission: Obtain a fresh, privacy-safe runtime receipt for the deployed browser voice surface and the authenticated study/class STT service, then document which surface is canonical for mobile voice capture versus class-session transcription. Do not persist private speech, room tokens, credentials, or transcript content in repo evidence.
definition_of_done: A fresh /pages/voice/ microphone-to-text run on a representative browser/device is recorded as success or exact failure without storing private speech content.
A fresh study-transcribe-v1 self-test is recorded as success or exact service/auth boundary without exposing credentials or private transcript text.
The canonical-role split is persisted: browser/mobile voice inbox versus authenticated class transcription, or exact SOURCE_DEBT remains if evidence is insufficient.
Exact URLs/paths/runtime timestamps and non-sensitive receipts are recorded.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog, production /w, credential, or irreversible authority boundary is changed.
